Maya (PM): Quick sync Proposing a 6-week 'performance handshake' beta for latency-sensitive features. Need a tiny screener, scoring, and hard stopgates. Start outreach Mon?
Rory (Field Eng): +1. Keep screener 3 fields: feature blurb, target p95, dev ETA. One-line yes/no for shipped-llm.
Asha (Design): I'll craft microcopy and a brief onboarding banner. Suggest success checkboxes: lower latency / lower cost / better UX.
Ben (SRE): We can offer a single Dedicated fast-track slot per week for top partners, else hosted with fallback. Need runbook + oncall hours in invite.
Lydia (Legal): If we collect request/response logs add consent checkbox and retention choices (30/90/365). Default 30. I'll draft wording.
Sam (Growth): A/B subject lines: A "Help us hit sub-100ms" vs B "Reduce your inference cost". Track reply + integration rate.
Maya (PM): Scoring idea: fit (1-4), effort (1-4), impact (1-4). Threshold >=10 and veto on on-prem-only.
Rory (Field Eng): Onboarding checklist: scoped API key, model pin, baseline evals, canary routing (5-20%). I'll add a `curl` snippet.
Ben (SRE): Launch gates: Recruit >=8 qualified across personas; Onboard >=3 validated in staging; Safety: no single partner causes >15% SLO breach; Value: >=2 partners show >=15% median latency improvement. Pause if any gate fails.
Asha (Design): Incentives: $400 credit (startups) or co-marketing case study (enterprise). Offer both.
Lydia (Legal): Posting consent draft later today. Also require partner acceptance for any debug data access.
Maya (PM): Action owners: Rory = screener + curl; Asha = banner + copy; Ben = runbook + gates; Lydia = consent; Sam = HubSpot + A/B. I'll pull into a 1-pager by Thu EOD. If no objections, outreach Monday. :rocket:
